subject: Onramp sequencing & desired sign path for BioTrace MAP / evaluation
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@biotrace.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@biotrace.com>, Mark Chen <m.chen@biotrace.com>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BioTrace MAP + evaluation plan — where to sequence MSA/DPA/order form?

Hi David —

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is the MAP we've been iterating on internally (BioTrace_MAP_v1.pdf). High level ask: we want a clear close path so our Security and Legal teams can finish approval in parallel with the technical eval. A few items we need you to confirm: 

- Can Redwood accept our standard DPA before we execute order form? (security asked to lock DPA before payment)
- What is your recommended sequencing for MSA / DPA / Order Form so we don't block the PoC start?
- We'll need SOC 2 evidence, a short token retention policy, and a network diagram for the sandbox environment.
- Target close window: end of June; can we compress to mid-June if legal moves quickly?

Attached: BioTrace_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP, owners & milestones).

Next steps: can you share a proposed milestone sequencing (owner + days) and a suggested sign path (DPA-first vs MSA-first)? Also please include the contact we should give procurement for PO vs order form.

Best,
Hannah Li
Head of Product, BioTrace Labs
---
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@biotrace.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BioTrace MAP + evaluation plan — where to sequence MSA/DPA/order form?

Hannah — thanks for the MAP and clear asks. I've sketched a practical sequencing below that balances your security needs with a fast PoC start. Attaching a one-page proposed sequence CSV (inline summary here).

Proposed high-level sequencing (target durations are business days):
- Week 0 (parallel): Redwood provides SOC2 snapshot, token retention summary, and sandbox network diagram (we can deliver within 2 business days).
- Day 1–10: Legal review (we can circulate our MSA draft and accept redlines).
- Day 1–10 (parallel): DPA redline review — we can accept your DPA redlines and confirm data-handling controls; if BioTrace requires DPA signed before payment, we recommend finalizing DPA by Day 10.
- Day 11–15: Procurement step — order form/PO negotiation once DPA/MSA terms agreed; finance processing (PO) varies by org but typically 3–7 business days.
- Day 1–30 (concurrent): Technical eval (sandbox onboarding + sample ingest). We can start sandbox access as soon as your security sign-off team confirms the network diagram and scope.

If BioTrace insists on DPA-first, we can prioritize that and run the MSA negotiation in parallel to avoid delay on Day 11. If you want acceleration to mid-June, we can compress legal windows by increasing overlap and providing a single consolidated redline set from Redwood to speed iteration.

Action items for BioTrace: confirm internal approvers for Legal, Security, and Procurement; share procurement contact for PO routing; confirm whether DPA must be signed prior to any sandbox access.

I've cc'd Laura for procurement sequencing details and Karthik for the eval acceptance criteria. I attached: MSA_redwood_draft.docx (our baseline), BioTrace_MAP_v1.pdf (your MAP).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min close-planning call if helpful.

--
David Kim
Manager, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Mark Chen <m.chen@biotrace.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@biotrace.com>
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BioTrace MAP + evaluation plan — where to sequence MSA/DPA/order form?

David / Hannah — quick clarifying note from Legal. BioTrace's policy for regulated projects requires the DPA to be approved before finance issues payment instruments (PO/credit). That means: DPA approval -> order form/PO -> payment. Legal items we will be looking at next: indemnity cap, data deletion/tokens, subprocessors list, and audit rights.

Attached: Redlines_MSA_BioTrace.docx (initial redlines + comments on DPA expectations).

Also: can Redwood provide (or point to) your SOC 2 Type II report and a short summary of token retention and access logs (we'll need that for evidence gates). If possible, provide a sandbox network diagram specifying egress rules — helps our Security team sign off faster.

- Mark Chen
General Counsel, BioTrace Labs
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mark Chen <m.chen@biotrace.com>, Hannah Li <hannah.li@biotrace.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BioTrace MAP + evaluation plan — where to sequence MSA/DPA/order form?

Mark / Hannah — appreciate the clarity. From Procurement perspective the gating sequence below is what we typically need to move from PoC -> paid pilot -> production. If BioTrace requires DPA-first, that is fine — we will prioritize.

Procurement gating checklist (summary):
- Legal sign-off: MSA redlines resolved OR mutually agreed follow-up items documented.
- DPA sign-off: final DPA executed if required by customer policy.
- Security evidence: SOC2 snapshot, network diagram, token retention policy.
- Billing terms: PO vs Order Form decision; who issues PO and billing contact.
- Finance hold-ups: external vendors sometimes require vendor setup (W-9, tax docs).

Suggested parallel moves to shorten timeline:
1) Redwood provides SOC2 & sandbox diagram immediately (Day 0–2).
2) BioTrace Legal sends consolidated redlines by Day 3.
3) Redwood returns a consolidated response within 3 business days.
4) Procurement team can start vendor onboarding and PO intake while legal finalizes DPA (saves ~7 business days).

Attached: procurement_gate_checklist.xlsx (detailed fields & owners). If you want, we can create a shared MAP with explicit owners and sign lanes; I can own the procurement lane for Redwood and track PO status.

Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Li <hannah.li@biotrace.com>, Mark Chen <m.chen@biotrace.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BioTrace MAP + evaluation plan — where to sequence MSA/DPA/order form?

Team — technical acceptance notes and ways to parallelize work: 

Acceptance & eval plan (key items):
- Sandbox: we can provision a private sandbox environment (VPC peering) within 2 business days after we confirm IP ranges and egress rules.
- Data: we only need a 1–2 GB sample of de-identified data for initial perf/latency tests. If regulated, we can use synthetic data — provide format/schema.
- KPIs: median 95th percentile latency < 150ms for inference path (with 8k token windows), throughput target: 20 qps sustained with burst to 80.
- Integration: API key vs mutual TLS option (mTLS available for Private deployments).
- On-prem/private lead time: if Biotrace opts for Private deployment, procurement and infra prep add 4–6 weeks.

Recommendations to compress timeline: start sandbox provisioning (network + accounts) while Legal/DPA are under review. We can limit early sandbox access to a single app team and IPs until DPA is final — many customers accept this approach as it reduces wall time.

Attaching the eval_plan_v2.md (detailed checkpoints). Happy to align with your security folks on the exact schema.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@biotrace.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <m.chen@biotrace.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@biotrace.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BioTrace MAP + evaluation plan — where to sequence MSA/DPA/order form?

David / Laura / Karthik — this is great, thank you. A few quick confirmations from BioTrace: 

- Procurement: procurement@biotrace.com is the PO contact and can issue PO once DPA is executed.
- DPA-first: our Security & Legal prefer DPA approved before the PO; we can allow limited sandbox access (synthetic data) while legal finishes DPA as a compromise.
- Acceleration: we want to target a mid-June close if Redwood can prioritize the DPA review and provide SOC2/tokens diagram in next 48 hours. We are willing to accept a modest early-purchase credit (one month) in exchange for a 2-week acceleration — please let us know if Redwood can offer a short-term concession.

Attached: BioTrace_MAP_v2.pdf (MAP with named approvers). Please send a consolidated redline bundle (DPA + MSA) and a DocuSign package if possible — we prefer a DPA + Order Form bundle so Procurement can sign once DPA is green. Also let us know available times for a 30-minute close-planning call this week.

Thanks,
Hannah Li
Head of Product, BioTrace Labs
